companies.name: LGエナジーソリューション

relations.text: 電池セル生産のUltium Cellsを折半出資の合弁として運営している
relations.text_en: Ultium Cells, the battery cell producer, is run as an equally owned joint venture

source.label: GM 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our EV portfolio takes advantage of integrated supply chain development, including battery cell production from Ultium Cells Holdings LLC (a joint venture with LG Energy Solution) in plants in Warren, Ohio and Spring Hill, Tennessee.

relations.text: 中国の合弁SGMをSAICと50%ずつで設立した
relations.text_en: SGM was set up with SAIC, with SAIC holding 50%

source.label: GM 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: SGM is a joint venture we established with Shanghai Automotive Industry Corporation (SAIC) ( 50 %).

relations.text: 2017年にオペル/ボクスホール事業を売却した相手で、補償義務が残る
relations.text_en: Stellantis bought the Opel/Vauxhall business in 2017, and GM retains indemnification obligations

source.label: GM 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In 2017, we sold the Opel/Vauxhall Business to PSA Group, now Stellantis N.V. (Stellantis), under a Master Agreement (the Agreement).

companies.name: リチウム・アメリカズ

relations.text: リチウム・アメリカズへ投資を行っている
relations.text_en: GM has made an investment in Lithium Americas

source.label: GM 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: $(0.3) billion investment in Lithium Americas in the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
